nodes.label: M000
nodes.summary: Milestone and DAG driven development

nodes.label: M001
nodes.summary: A blocking question survives a handover

nodes.label: M002
nodes.summary: A durable record names the worker that wrote it

nodes.label: M003
nodes.summary: A session is a durable envelope, and knowledge is compiled from what is already canonical

nodes.label: M004
nodes.summary: Performance is executable evidence, and the hot path does no canonical work twice

nodes.label: 0.1  foundation
nodes.summary: A supervisory control layer that is real rather than described

nodes.label: fly-deployment
nodes.summary: A deployment is a projection of the repository model, and a reachable URL is its evidence

nodes.label: web-sign-in
nodes.summary: The deployed surfaces know who is asking, and the identity providers are data

nodes.label: capability-graph
nodes.summary: One capability graph, two projections, and no second inventory of what this repository can do

nodes.label: external-workspaces
nodes.summary: An external workspace is read the way this repository reads anything else, and its content never becomes public by accident

nodes.label: two-folder-integration
nodes.summary: A repository that adopts Majordomus gains two directories and two lines, and can give them back

nodes.label: 0.5  derived-data-integrity
nodes.summary: A committed derivation describes something it can be a projection of

nodes.label: work-graph-github
nodes.summary: The projection to GitHub is gated, identified and traversable, and a merged pull request leads back to the outcome it served

nodes.label: intent-lifecycle
nodes.summary: Work is traceable to the intent it serves, and an intent is satisfied only by evidence

nodes.label: 0.6  development-runtime
nodes.summary: The runtime has a development surface

nodes.label: test-evidence
nodes.summary: Every verifiable claim and widget resolves to revision-bound test evidence, on every surface

nodes.label: public-proof
nodes.summary: A visitor sees the product prove itself, and can check every claim it makes

nodes.label: adopter-upgrades
nodes.summary: An adopting repository survives a Majordomus upgrade, and what the tool vendors into it is adopter-neutral

nodes.label: runtime-trust
nodes.summary: A runtime is safe to reach from another machine, and joining the mesh trusts nobody by accident

nodes.label: runtime-lifecycle
nodes.summary: One usable server per checkout starts, attaches, stops and reports its state without races or hidden kills

nodes.label: mesh-journal-converges
nodes.summary: The cooperation journal is durable, converges under any delivery order, and never lets a stale claim win

nodes.label: work-is-coordinated
nodes.summary: Work is allocated and enforced through one typed task model, not observed on a board

nodes.label: mcp-transports-are-reliable
nodes.summary: Every MCP transport delivers each request at most once, bounds what it carries, and honours cancellation

nodes.label: surfaces-never-disagree
nodes.summary: Every surface projects the same state, says when it was observed, and keeps no list of its own

nodes.label: cockpit-control-center
nodes.summary: A person can follow and steer the coordination of work from the Cockpit, and every action asks before it writes

nodes.label: failure-is-visible
nodes.summary: Every failure the runtime can suffer is bounded, tested or stated, and changes the health it reports

nodes.label: architecture-is-enforced
nodes.summary: A violated invariant fails a gate, and green means every required check ran

nodes.label: safe-self-update
nodes.summary: Clients and servers of different versions meet safely, and a release's provenance can be checked

nodes.label: an-outcome-becomes-a-reviewed-plan
nodes.summary: A desired outcome becomes a draft plan that is checked before a record is written

nodes.label: the-intent-loop-is-proved-end-to-end
nodes.summary: The intent loop is proved end to end, and the plan and the documents say what it does

nodes.label: an-unmet-criterion-is-drafted-into-work
nodes.summary: An unmet criterion is drafted into work from the evidence, and the draft is the same on every run

nodes.label: command-and-deployment-criteria-are-judged
nodes.summary: A command or deployment criterion is met by a recorded run of exactly that command, or an observation of exactly that deployment, current at the presented revision

nodes.label: a-fact-is-written-once
nodes.summary: A fact is written once, the register of the copies that remain is checked, and an object added anywhere reaches every surface

nodes.label: a-client-lists-only-the-tools-it-needs
nodes.summary: What an MCP client reads before its first call is measured, budgeted, and proportional to the task

nodes.label: adoption-is-light
nodes.summary: A new repository adopts the lifecycle with few files, no default push, and a journey a test walks

nodes.label: optional-subsystems-are-measured
nodes.summary: Each optional subsystem has a measured cost, and the task lifecycle needs none of them

nodes.label: policy-and-scope-read-exactly
nodes.summary: Every reader of a record reads the same values, and scope judges the change a task leaves

nodes.label: a-release-is-followed-to-its-users
nodes.summary: Every surface can tell which stage a release is at, from the bump to the installer that serves it, and a release in flight is not reported as a lost one

nodes.label: 0.2  runtime-adapters
nodes.summary: Profiles become runtime constraints rather than advice

nodes.label: intent-planning
nodes.summary: The plan of an intent is held to it before execution

nodes.label: a-provider-hook-refuses-an-out-of-scope-edit
nodes.summary: A provider that can refuse a tool call refuses an edit outside the task's scope before it is written

nodes.label: first-runs-by-strangers-are-recorded
nodes.summary: A stranger's first run can be observed with consent, recorded, and summarised from the same records

nodes.label: a-browser-is-a-read-only-peer
nodes.summary: One browser on this machine is a paired peer of the local runtime and answers one read-only request, with provenance, on every surface

nodes.label: 0.3  execution-telemetry
nodes.summary: Execution telemetry, only from providers that expose it honestly

nodes.label: intent-bound-work
nodes.summary: A task is bound to the intent it serves

nodes.label: browsers-act-and-cooperate-under-policy
nodes.summary: Paired browsers act only inside a declared origin policy, several of them answer one request, and what they read can be kept as evidence

nodes.label: 0.4  cost-per-accepted-outcome
nodes.summary: Cost per accepted outcome, only on measured data

nodes.label: 0.5  routing-recommendations
nodes.summary: Routing recommendations derived from measured cost

nodes.label: 1.0  shared-policy
nodes.summary: Shared policy across repositories and workers
